findings.message: GameRatingRecord.itemKey's doc comment in src/domain/game/types.ts still described the pre-fix bare symbolCharacter/thaiWord key format, not the kind-prefixed format itemKeyOf now produces (the round-1 fix for the cross-kind collision, F1). Repaired: updated the comment to describe the current `kind:`-prefixed format and point at itemKeyOf.
